The '''Donadus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Bamula sector/Legends|Bamula sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Donadus]].
